title: goalforge finding v1
description: One flat JSON finding, schema_version 1. Normative spec: references/finding-contract.md. SARIF 2.1.0 is the import/export mapping, not the wire format. Per-producer mandatory fields are encoded as allOf of if/then; the only validator in this package (goalforge-trace-emit `_validate`) supports allOf and if/then but not `$ref`, so every subschema is written out at its site. `suppression`, `baseline_state` and `route_to` are reserved: producers never set them, consumers stamp them.

rule_id.description: Mandatory for deterministic producers, optional for model producers.

why_it_matters.description: Concrete failure or exploit scenario. Mandatory for model producers.

trace.description: Source to sink. Mandatory when producer.kind is deterministic and analysis_kind is taint or path.

fingerprint.description: Mandatory for deterministic producers; model producers do not emit it (not enforced in v1). Key and algorithm owned by ticket-03.

suppression.description: Reserved, consumer-stamped (ticket-22). Producers never set it.

baseline_state.description: Reserved, consumer-stamped (ticket-03). Producers never set it.

route_to.description: Reserved, consumer-stamped (ticket-30). Producers never set it.
